purpose: Define the minimum evidence-bearing structure that a real concrete comparison contract must satisfy before Task 8 may perform candidate-specific applicability, comparator selection, implementation/version/configuration binding, or immutable baseline pinning.

concrete_experiment_contract_definition.definition: A real concrete comparison contract is an immutable/versioned execution-intent record that binds an already-governed scientific hypothesis to an actual system/task, candidate-under-test, evaluator/metric, real Task-7 split identities, information-opportunity regime, required comparator roles, applicable Task-9 resource regime, and pre-protected freeze/change-control semantics.

universal_required_sections.rule: The contract has a stable logical identity and an immutable behavior-relevant version. A material comparison change creates a successor version rather than rewriting prior evidence.
The concrete experiment must instantiate an already-governed hypothesis and must not silently broaden its claim.
Environment-family taxonomy alone is insufficient. The contract must identify the actual system/task being compared.
A baseline cannot be meaningfully matched without knowing the actual candidate behavior and configuration being compared.
The evaluation measure and evaluator must be concrete enough that candidate and baseline are judged under the same declared semantics.
Protected-result interpretation cannot be invented after execution.
The contract must bind real Task-7 split identities and evidence boundaries. A hypothetical or placeholder split does not qualify.
Applicability and fairness depend on what each compared system is permitted to observe and use.
This section declares roles only. It must not contain a selected candidate ID until Task-8 applicability and selection are executed for this concrete contract.
Where the scientific claim requires matched resources or bounded adaptation cost, the concrete accounting regime must exist before claim-bearing comparison.
The contract must define enough execution identity to distinguish a reproducible comparison from a conceptual comparison.
Baseline selection and comparison configuration must be frozen before applicable protected outcomes are inspected. Material later changes create successor evidence.

N-H1.note: Evidence for one decision behavior must not be generalized to the others.

N-H2.note: Within-family transfer is not a substitute for the governed cross-family transfer boundary.

A-H1.note: Adaptation input and protected outcome evidence must remain separated.

A-H2.note: A-H2 retention, locality, invariant, rollback, and restoration evidence cannot be replaced by an arbitrary external comparator.

realness_criteria: Every required identity resolves to an existing governed or executable artifact rather than an invented placeholder.
The concrete system/task identity is real and versioned or snapshot-bound.
The evaluator and primary metric are executable or governed by an explicit binding rule.
The Task-7 split version and applicable partitions actually exist.
Required Task-9 resource accounting references exist when the hypothesis requires resource matching or bounded adaptation cost.
The candidate-under-test identity and configuration are concrete.
Information opportunity is explicit for both candidate and future comparator.
Required comparator roles are declared before candidate-specific baseline selection.
Protected outcomes have not been inspected before the contract and applicable baseline binding freeze.
Required fields do not use placeholder values such as TODO, TBA, UNKNOWN, DUMMY, or HYPOTHETICAL.
task8_binding_prerequisites: all universally applicable required sections are complete
all hypothesis-specific required fields are complete
all referenced artifacts resolve and pass identity/hash/version validation where applicable
candidate and comparator information-opportunity regime is fixed
selection must operate only over candidates applicable to this concrete contract
prohibitions: Do not mechanically cross-product all 222 catalog candidates with hypothetical experiments.
Do not rank the 222-candidate catalog globally.
Do not select a comparator before a real concrete experiment contract is structurally validated.
Do not create split versions owned by Task 7 inside this boundary artifact.
Do not invent Task-9 accounting values.
Do not pin immutable candidate versions before experiment-specific applicability and retention are determined.
Do not inspect protected outcomes to decide applicability, exclusion, ranking, or baseline selection.
Do not manufacture N-H2 cross-family applicability from within-family transfer evidence.
Do not create a Task-8 governing specification or Decision 0009 from this boundary alone.

validation_states.DRAFT: May contain unresolved required fields. No Task-8 candidate-specific binding allowed.
validation_states.STRUCTURALLY_COMPLETE_UNVALIDATED: All fields present, but referenced identities have not all been validated. No Task-8 candidate-specific binding allowed.
validation_states.CONCRETE_READY_FOR_TASK8_BASELINE_BINDIN: All applicable required fields are concrete, referenced artifacts resolve, protected outcomes remain uninspected, and Task 8 may begin experiment-specific applicability and comparator selection.
validation_states.FROZEN_FOR_PROTECTED_COMPARISON: Task-8 baseline identity/version/configuration and applicable Task-9 resource regime have subsequently been bound and frozen before protected outcome inspection. This state is NOT created by R12.
validation_states.INVALID: The contract is structurally or scientifically invalid and cannot authorize baseline binding.
